messages:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off a canary backfill for tenant_migration now. Adding idx_user_email_hash and filling null emails. Please watch for lock spikes.

deploybot: Started migration run mg-8472 on cluster canary-3 (initiated by maria).

alex: Copy. can you paste the exact SQL change?

maria: It's a straightforward index-add + backfill. snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email_hash bytea;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_user_email_hash ON users (email_hash);
-- backfill: update users set email_hash = sha256(email) where email is not null;
```

sam: Note — our SLO says any row-lock > 10s during business hours => abort. I'll watch.

jeff: Also draft release note: warn downstream teams about delayed writes to /signup if concurrency spikes.

amy: Before aborting, prefer to drop concurrency from 4 -> 1. Less disruptive than full rollback.

maria: good call. throttling now: `/deploybot update-migration mg-8472 --concurrency=1`

deploybot: Ack. concurrency set to 1 for mg-8472.

deploybot: Observability: users_shard_17 rows scanned=4800, avg row lock=3s.

oncall-bot: Reminder: alert rule migration_row_lock_time > 5s will page oncall.

alex: Can we pin the migration schema in canary services to avoid auto-retry? ACTION: set env MIGRATION_SCHEMA=v2026_03_15b

sam: I pushed the pin to canary envs (canary-3).

maria: Running a quick cardinality check before continuing: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE email IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '90 days';` -> 12,384 rows.

jeff: If that number unexpectedly spikes, our fallback is the fallback_index variant (creates partial index + deferred backfill). How fast to flip?

amy: ~2 minutes: abort-migration then deploy index swap. maria: I can trigger rollback in ~2m.

deploybot: metric update (1739456840): users_shard_17 lock_time=11s (window average 11.2s) — exceeding threshold. Per policy, aborting.

deploybot: Abort initiated for mg-8472. status=aborting.

amy: Confirmed abort in progress.

jeff: Draft release note line: 'mg-8472 aborted due to lock escalation; reverted index changes; canary pinned to prevent auto-retry.'

maria: I've pinned MIGRATION_SCHEMA=v2026_03_15b on canary to block re-run. pin set at ts=1739456842.

alex: Logged the incident and opened a follow-up to review throttling defaults + alert thresholds.

sam: We'll run a small blast test on a staging shard with concurrency 1 and extended sampling before reattempt.

maria: I'll update the migration runbook with new default concurrency=1 and the abort threshold. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

jeff: Adding action: update release notes + notify product about delayed rollout.

amy: ping me once the brief postmortem is up and I'll add operator guidance.

maria: Closing canary window for this change. Reopen when we have validated smaller blast.

deploybot: Final state for mg-8472: aborted at 1739456848, locks released, traffic normal.

oncall-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-0315-42 for postmortem.

maria: Thanks everyone — follow-up doc incoming.
